title: ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.target: Sociodemographic bias (Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Age, Disability, National Origin)
bias_targets.methodology: Human annotation of model-generated images to identify if the output portrays members of protected classes in a derogatory, defamatory, or prejudiced manner (evaluated as part of the broader 'Harmlessness' criteria).
